bullets.title: SMCI: Massive Q1 Preannouncement — Revenue +27% Above Guidance on AI Demand
bullets.body: SMCI raised preliminary FQ1 2027 revenue to $18.5–19.5B from $14.5–15.5B guidance (vs. $15B consensus), driven by surging AI platform demand. Gross margins also beat at 12.0–12.5% vs. prior 10.4–10.8% guidance. DELL +6.8% and HPE +4.5% in sympathy premarket.

bullets.title: NVDA/AI Infra: SPCX Beat + 13GW Capacity Target Drives AI Supply Chain Rally
bullets.body: SpaceX Q3 revenue +161% to $14.6B (vs. $12.8B est.), raised 2026 nameplate compute capacity to 2.5–3GW from >2GW and targets 13GW by end-2027 with 20GW+ upside; 4Q capex guided $35–40B vs. $20B consensus. Sub-1-year payback periods on new capacity underpin continued NVDA chip demand; SPCX exclusively uses NVDA chips. Wolfe maintains NVDA Outperform at $275 PT.

bullets.title: NFLX: -7% Premarket on Q4 Revenue Miss and Ad Shortfall
bullets.body: NFLX Q3 beat on revenue and EPS but Q4 guidance disappointed; ad revenue outlook cut from $3B to $2.7B due to third-party integration delays and slower-than-expected US engagement momentum. FY FCF guide trimmed from $12.5B to ~$12B. GS notes stock now at 14x CY28 GAAP EPS, ~50% below ATHs and at new 2-year lows; Citi notes NFLX trades at 18x '27 EPS vs. DIS at 15x.

bullets.title: META: Q3 Earnings Tonight; 2027 Capex Guided $225–250B, Revenue Guide at High End
bullets.body: META 4Q26 revenue guidance $75B at high end (vs. $74B consensus); 2027 capex projected $225–250B vs. $201B consensus. Muse hit 10M US downloads in 40 days with strong retention; Gemini 4 Argon hit ~25T tokens in first 72 hours (~3x Gemini 3). MS hosting post-earnings callback Thursday 9am ET with Brian Nowak.

bullets.title: T: Beats Q3 But Shares -7% on SpaceX Wireless Entry Threat in 2028
bullets.body: AT&T Q3 EBITDA $12.51B beat ($12.32B cons); revenue $32.30B beat; raised FY26 EPS guidance to ~$2.40 and reduced 2027–28 capex to $22–23B annually. Despite solid fiber adds (442K beat) and ARPU upside, shares fell ~7% after SpaceX confirmed plans to enter US wireless market in 2028. Citi maintains Buy at $28 PT, viewing 4Q EBITDA guide as conservative.

bullets.title: COF: +22% EPS Beat on $694M Lighter Provision; Synergies Ahead of Schedule
bullets.body: Capital One adjusted EPS $6.69 beat consensus $5.50 by $1.19; ~$0.88 of the beat came from $694M lighter provision (lower NCOs + $225M reserve release). Domestic card purchase volume +11% YoY; 30+ delinquency 3.74% down 15bps YoY though improvement rate is flatlining. JPM raised PT to $241 from $227 (OW); combined Discover synergies at ~$1.8B annualized, ahead of schedule.

bullets.title: MCO: 3Q26 Miss — MIS Deceleration, Leveraged Finance Weakness; FY Guide Held
bullets.body: MCO reported revenue $2,023M (-2.6% vs. Street) and adjusted EPS $4.14 (-3.1% vs. Street); MIS organic CC revenue decelerated sharply from +16% in 2Q to +3% in 3Q, with HY deals -40% and leveraged loans -27%. MA ARR growth ticked down ~100bps to +8% YoY. FY26 guidance reaffirmed but 4Q issuance guided down mid-teens; stock -3% premarket.

bullets.title: AMZN: Hedgeye Upgrades to Top Idea Long, 30% Upside; AWS Accelerating to 41% Q4
bullets.body: Hedgeye projects AWS growth accelerating to 38.1% Q3 and 41.0% Q4 vs. consensus flat ~37%; $496B backlog and $220B capex budget. Q4 sales modeled at $251.4B (+2.9% vs. consensus) and Q4 operating income $33.9B (+2.4% vs. consensus). Alexa for Shopping used by 300M+ customers; grocery passed $150B gross sales.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Pichai Flags Compute as #1 Priority; Capacity for 2027 'Extremely Difficult' to Secure
bullets.body: Alphabet CEO Pichai says frontier model development is the top priority and GOOGL is foregoing short-term revenue for compute R&D; securing compute capacity for 2027 described as 'extremely difficult.' GOOGL preparing persistent autonomous consumer agents spanning Gemini, Search, Gmail, and Workspace. Stock -1.2% premarket.

bullets.title: MU: Reaffirms Multi-Year AI Memory Runway; 1-Delta DRAM and Gen 11 NAND Target H2 2027
bullets.body: Micron's business update call emphasized AI-driven memory demand is in early innings with no supply balance expected for several years. Key node targets: 1-delta DRAM (mid-20s% density improvement) and Gen 11 NAND (2x bit density vs. Gen 9, 1.5x speed) both targeting H2 2027 volume ramp. Vertical HBM positioned as major future product; $10B over 10 years committed to Micron Research Labs. Taiwan labor dispute averted after signing agreement with union.

bullets.title: NET: Bullish Checks Support Q3 Acceleration; Citi Raises PT to $400
bullets.body: Citi reiterates Buy on Cloudflare, raises PT to $400; channel checks indicate portfolio adoption broadening beyond app/web into Workers and AI Gateway SKUs, with Q3 guidance viewed as conservative. Cybersecurity names broadly higher today on news that an AI tool discovered a severe PHP bug affecting up to 70% of websites, creating patching urgency.

bullets.title: CRM: Acquires Braze at $47.50/Share; DA Davidson Raises PT to $250, Sees ZETA as Beneficiary
bullets.body: Salesforce acquiring Braze for $47.50/share ($5.66B EV); Braze downgraded to Neutral at DA Davidson post-deal. Davidson raises CRM PT to $250 (16x FY28 EPS) despite integration risks; upgrades ZETA to Buy citing RFP displacement as legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud shrinks. ZETA trades at 24x CY27 FCF vs. Braze at 36x under Salesforce.

bullets.title: EQIX/DLR: Both Upgraded to Outperform as AI Data Center Demand Stays Robust
bullets.body: DLR upgraded to Outperform with $213 PT; EQIX upgraded to Outperform with $1,200 PT. Jefferies notes 30 GW of projected 2028–30 data center deliveries potentially impacted by midterm election outcomes in TX/GA/OH, but NIMBYism structurally favors incumbents like DLR and EQIX by widening mark-to-market spreads on expiring leases.

bullets.title: BE: Fuel Cell CCUS Opportunity Into Earnings; Oracle Project Jupiter Validation
bullets.body: Bloom Energy's fuel cells produce 95% CO2 exhaust vs. 5% for engines/turbines, enabling ~50% reduction in CCUS system cost; Oracle Project Jupiter achieved 35% emissions reduction likely via BE integration. OPCO sees BE 25% pullback into earnings as supported by the CCUS opportunity with net-neutral cost positioning for data center operators facing regulatory pressure. BE rallying on AI infrastructure sentiment.

bullets.title: CRWV: Piper Reiterates as Preferred AIaaS Name; Financing Concerns Most Overblown vs. Peers
bullets.body: Piper reiterates CoreWeave as preferred name in AIaaS, arguing financing concerns are most overblown there vs. peers given most conservative assumptions and most favorable financing position. AIaaS names broadly down >25% on AI demand/ROIC/financing fears. Hedgeye separately maintains CoreWeave as a short citing financing risk.

bullets.title: MSFT/AAPL: Hedgeye Moves Both to Bullish TRADE and TREND; Bought on Broadening Signal
bullets.body: Keith McCullough at Hedgeye purchased Microsoft, Apple, and Amazon as all three moved to bullish TRADE and TREND signals, driven by a broadening market signal away from QQQ concentration. Software exposure overall reduced to 6% minimum; XLK (which has heavy NVDA exposure) among ETF laggards this week.

bullets.title: WDC: F1Q27 Earnings Due 10/22; Street at $4.10 EPS, Focus on HAMR Ramp and AI Nearline Demand
bullets.body: Street expects WDC F1Q27 revenue $4.144B (vs. $4.10B guidance midpoint), gross margin 55.4%, EPS $4.10 (above $4.00 guidance). Nearline/40TB ePMR shipments grew +23% YoY in the June quarter. Key investor focus: HAMR ramp timeline, AI data center HDD demand, and FY27 gross margin outlook at 57.5% consensus.

bullets.title: SPOT: Citi Sees ~6% ARPU Upside from Family Plan Crackdown via QR Code Verification
bullets.body: Citi models a 2–13% ARPU improvement at Spotify (base case ~6%) as family plan QR code verification forces users onto Duo or Individual plans. Stock -1.5% premarket on broader trading activity.

bullets.title: Hyperscaler Capex Cycle: ~$900B in 2026 Growing to ~$1.5T in 2027; Credit Spreads Widening
bullets.body: MS estimates aggregate hyperscaler data center capex at ~$900B in 2026, growing ~60% YoY to ~$1.5T in 2027; META/AMZN/GOOGL/MSFT have ~$200B financing requirements supported by ~$1T operating cash flow. Equity-credit dislocation flagged: tech equities +5–7% while ORCL CDS widened to 350bps and AVGO to 160bps, suggesting positioning-driven equity move vs. fundamental credit stress.

bullets.title: TSLA: Investor Focus on Robotaxi/FSD vs. Margins; TSLA-SPCX Merger Special Committees Formed
bullets.body: Musk confirmed Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to evaluate a merger. TSLA reports today with consensus gross margin ex-credits at ~16–17%; investors more focused on Cybercab deployments and FSD v15 progress than near-term financials. MS analyst lowers GM PT to $95 from $101 but is bullish; views TSLA robotaxi narrative as primary catalyst.
